paper.title: Variational optimization of the amplitude of neural-network quantum many-body ground states
paper.authors: Jia-Qi Wang, Rong-Qiang He, Zhong-Yi Lu

results.system_description: 10x10 square lattice, periodic; J1 = 1, J2 = 0.5; S = sigma/2; total Sz = 0
results.source_location: Table III, p. 6 (row aCNN(C4v), column J2/J1 = 0.5)
results.eligibility_evidence: Variational energy of the aCNN state; VMC, DMRG and quoted RBM+PP/ViT rows are excluded.
results.notes: Transcribed from the cited location of the versioned arXiv source and checked against the printed token; curator review pending. Parenthesized uncertainties are recorded as reported, with their meaning left unspecified unless the paper states it.

results.system_description: Heisenberg, 10 × 10 · J = 1 · periodic · Sz = 0. H = J sum_<ij> S_i · S_j; spin-1/2 operators S = sigma/2; J = 1; no constant shift
results.source_location: Table "Ground state energies of the Heisenberg model with L = 10, 16 and 24" (tab:HM), row aCNN(C4v), column L = 10
results.eligibility_evidence: Variational energy of the aCNN state; VMC, DMRG, QMC and quoted rows are excluded.
results.notes: Periodic boundary conditions. Only the amplitude is optimized; the sign structure is fixed (Marshall sign rule for the Heisenberg and J1-J2 models, exact for J2 = 0 and approximate otherwise).

results.system_description: Transverse-field Ising, 8 × 8 · h/J = 3.05 · periodic. H = -J sum_<ij> sigma^z_i sigma^z_j - h sum_i sigma^x_i; Pauli matrices; J = 1; h = 3.05; no constant shift
results.variant: aCNN with C4v symmetry, positive amplitudes
results.source_location: Table "Ground state energies of the two-dimensional transverse field Ising model" (tab:TFIM), row aCNN(C4v), column L = 8
results.eligibility_evidence: Variational energy of the aCNN state; VMC, DMRG, QMC and quoted rows are excluded.
results.notes: Periodic boundary conditions. Only the amplitude is optimized; the sign structure is fixed (Marshall sign rule for the Heisenberg and J1-J2 models, exact for J2 = 0 and approximate otherwise). H = -sum sigma^z_i sigma^z_j - lambda sum sigma^x_i with Pauli matrices, lambda = 3.05, periodic boundaries; energy per site. The positive sign of the stoquastic ground state is imposed. The FATTN and FAMPS rows of the table are extrapolations.
